## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** A pre-sales-only story with no production code; vague "AI solutions" claims without customer outcomes

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Hardware / accelerator:** deployment work, not hardware work
- **Research craft:** not expected

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01): services channels [T0-11]
- **Optional:** Microsoft AI-103 (Azure AI apps and agents): Azure customers; beta [T0-11]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** One JD: 2–6 years and up to 50% travel [B · T0-01]. Only ~48% of the cluster is engineer-titled, so target those titles.
- **Proof to show:** A customer pilot case study with numbers; a demo on real data shown to at least two potential users; a deployment write-up that covers failure modes.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** forward deployed, FDE, customer-facing, deployment, integration, RAG, agents, travel.
